_comment: Domain-keyed platform identity registry. Kept SEPARATE from competitor-directory.json on purpose: the same competitor domain appears under several RAIN clients there (penfed.org, patelco.org, alliantcreditunion.org and others recur), so storing a Meta Page ID inside each occurrence would create several sources of truth that can silently disagree. One domain, one identity, here.

_schema.metaPageId: Facebook Page ID used for the ads query
_schema.metaPageName: Page name as the provider reported it
_schema.confidence: high | medium | low — from the resolver's score AND margin
_schema.verifiedAt: ISO timestamp of the last human confirmation
_schema.note: why this mapping is what it is, when non-obvious

lacapfcu.org.note: Single candidate, exact name match, 99.7% of ad destinations resolve to lacapfcu.org.

campusfederal.org.note: 15 candidates but a 0.459 margin over the runner-up; 76.7% destination match.

neighborsfcu.org.note: Resolved cleanly; returned ZERO ads in the 180-day probe. Resolution and emptiness are different facts and this registry records only the first.
